statements.claim: Orthonormality of the 1-D discrete sine basis on Fin N: Σ_i e_j(i) e_k(i) = δ_jk for j, k < N.
The 1-D Dirichlet lattice Laplacian has eigenvectors e_k with eigenvalues 4 sin²(π(k+1)/(2(N+1))).
The 2-D product sine vectors e_K are eigenvectors of the Dirichlet box operator dirOp with eigenvalue dirEig K (any m₀).
Spectral formula for the box Green function: dirGreen x y = Σ_K e_K(x) e_K(y) / λ_K, for every m₀ (dirGreen is the matrix inverse of dirOp; λ_K = dirEig K > 0).
Semigroup property of the box heat kernel p_t = exp(−t·dirOp) (spectral definition): Σ_z p_t(x,z) p_s(z,y) = p_{t+s}(x,y), all real t, s and any m₀.
The Bochner integral ∫_0^∞ p_t(x,y) dt of the box heat kernel equals dirGreen x y (stated for every m₀; λ_K = dirEig K > 0 makes it integrable).
One-dimensional diagonal heat bound: h(τ, i) ≤ √(π/(4τ)) for τ > 0, uniformly in the length N and the site i.
Diagonal heat-kernel bound uniform in n, k, x and m₀: ε⁻² p_t(x,x) ≤ π/(4t) for t > 0.
Torus orthogonality, iterated-integral form: ∫_{−π}^{π}∫_{−π}^{π} Σ_{i∈s} c_i cos(p_i·θ) = 4π² Σ_{p_i = 0} c_i for integer frequency vectors p_i.
Variational bound: for m₀ ≠ 0, every field v on the Dirichlet box and every site a, 2 v(a) − dirAction(v) ≤ freeVar (the infinite-lattice site variance at spacing ε = 2⁻ⁿ).
Dirichlet ≤ infinite volume: for m₀ ≠ 0 the site variance ε⁻² dirGreen a a of the Dirichlet free field is at most freeVar, at every box site a.
At the centre i = M of an odd box N = 2M+1: e_j(M)² = 1/(M+1) if j is even, and 0 if j is odd.
Centre-site identity: the spectral site variance specVar (2M+1) μ at the centre equals a midpoint Riemann sum over (M+1)² cells of [0,π]² of 1/w_μ, with weights (1/(M+1))².
For m₀ ≠ 0, freeVar = (1/π²) ∫_0^π∫_0^π 1/w(θ) dθ, w the lattice symbol at μ = m₀²ε² (interval integrals).
Boundary-strip bound (m₀ ≠ 0): freeVar − specVar(2M+1)(m₀²ε²) at the centre ≤ (1/π²)(∫_0^a∫_0^π 1/w + ∫_0^π∫_0^a 1/w), a = π/(2(M+1)).
First strip estimate: at μ = (4/π²)p², p > 0, and 0 ≤ a ≤ π, ∫_0^a∫_0^π 1/w_μ ≤ (π³/8)(1 + log⁺(a/p)).
The two boundary strips have equal integrals (θ₁ ↔ θ₂ symmetry), for μ > 0 and a ≥ 0.
For m₀ ≠ 0 and N = 2M+1: freeVar − specVar(2M+1)(m₀²ε²) at the centre ≤ (π/4)(1 + log⁺(1/(|m₀| ε (M+1)))).
Domain monotonicity (m₀ ≠ 0): for every region B of box sites, regionGreen B x y ≤ dirGreen x y entrywise on B × B.
Variational lower bound (m₀ ≠ 0): 2 v(a) − ⟨v, dirOp v⟩ ≤ dirGreen a a for every field v and site a.
If the odd sub-box of half-width M centred at x fits in the box (m₀ ≠ 0), its centre spectral variance specVar(2M+1)(m₀²ε²) is ≤ ε⁻² dirGreen x x.
Wick defect at a site with a fitting sub-box (m₀ ≠ 0): freeVar − ε⁻² dirGreen x x ≤ (π/4)(1 + log⁺(1/(|m₀| ε (M+1)))).
Wick defect bound at every box site (m₀ ≠ 0): freeVar − ε⁻² dirGreen x x ≤ (π/4)(1 + log⁺(1/(|m₀| r(x)))), r(x) = ε(M(x)+1) the physical distance to the Dirichlet boundary.
The box action of a zero-extended region field equals ε² ⟨ψ, regionOp B ψ⟩ (any m₀).
At λ = 0 and m₀ ≠ 0, the region two-point function equals ε⁻² regionGreen B x y.
For m₀ ≠ 0 the region Green function regionGreen B is entrywise nonnegative.
Free exit weight of a ball (m₀ ≠ 0, l ≥ 0): Σ_{u∈B} Σ_{v∉B} bondJ u v · ε⁻² regionGreen B (x,u) ≤ 2/cosh(κ l), κ = min(1,|m₀|)/2, B = physBall x l, uniformly in n, k, x.
For m₀ ≠ 0 the free exit weight of any region B from any y ∈ B is at most 1.
Wick binomial (Hermite addition) formula for wickPow: :(y+z)^j:_{c₁+c₂} = Σ_i C(j,i) :y^i:_{c₁} :z^{j−i}:_{c₂}, for all real c₁, c₂, y, z.
The quartic Wick split used in Nelson's estimate: :(y+z)⁴:_{c₁+c₂} = :y⁴: + 4:y³:z + 6:y²::z²: + 4y:z³: + :z⁴: (with constants c₁ for y, c₂ for z).
Scaling of Wick powers: :(a y)^k:_{a²c} = a^k :y^k:_c.
One-dimensional Gaussian orthogonality, degrees ≤ 4: for the centred Gaussian of variance v ≥ 0, E[:x^j:_v :x^k:_v] = δ_jk j! v^j.
Cross orthogonality, degrees ≤ 4: for x ~ γ_c, w ~ γ_d independent and Y = a x + w, E[:x^j:_c :Y^k:_{a²c+d}] = δ_jk j! (a c)^j.
Covariance form: for c > 0, r² ≤ c c', the pair (x, (r/c)x + w), x ~ γ_c, w ~ γ_{c'−r²/c}, satisfies E[:X^j:_c :Y^k:_{c'}] = δ_jk j! r^j for j, k ≤ 4.
Fréchet derivative of φ ↦ φ_u E(φ) (E = exp(−λ e Σ :φ⁴:_c)): ∂_v(φ_u E) = E · (v_u − λ φ_u D(φ, v)).
Fréchet derivative of φ ↦ :φ_y³:_c E(φ): equals E · (3 :φ_y²: v_y − λ :φ_y³: D(φ, v)).
For A positive definite, e ≥ 0, λ ≥ 0: any continuous h with |h(φ)| ≤ K exp(2Σ|φ_j|) is integrable against the interacting weight W = gaussWeight A · E.
First Gaussian integration by parts, unnormalised (A ≻ 0, e, λ ≥ 0): ∫ φ_xφ_u W = A⁻¹(x,u) ∫W − 4λe Σ_y A⁻¹(x,y) ∫ φ_u :φ_y³:_c W.
Second integration by parts, unnormalised: ∫ φ_u :φ_y³: W = 3A⁻¹(u,y) ∫ :φ_y²: W − 4λe Σ_z A⁻¹(u,z) ∫ :φ_y³::φ_z³: W.
Double integration by parts, normalised (A ≻ 0, e, λ ≥ 0, g = A⁻¹t): Σ_u t_u⟨φ_xφ_u⟩ = g(x) − 12λe Σ_z g(z)A⁻¹(x,z)⟨:φ_z²:⟩ + 16λ²⟨F₁F_g⟩ (⟨·⟩ a ratio of Bochner integrals).
I1 on the Dirichlet box (m₀ ≠ 0, λ ≥ 0, Wick constant freeVar, G = ε⁻² dirGreen, g = Gt): Σ_u t_u⟨φ_xφ_u⟩ = g(x) − 12λε² Σ_z g(z)G(x,z)⟨:φ_z²:⟩ + 16λ²⟨F₁F_g⟩.
I1 for a region B (m₀ ≠ 0, λ ≥ 0, C_B = ε⁻² regionGreen B, g = C_B t): Σ_u t_u regionTwoPt(a,u) = g(a) − 12λε² Σ_z g(z)C_B(a,z)⟨:ψ_z²:⟩_B + 16λ²⟨F₁F_g⟩_B.
Hermite recursion for Wick powers, j ≤ 2: :y^{j+2}:_c = y :y^{j+1}:_c − (j+1) c :y^j:_c.
G3 recursion, unnormalised (A ≻ 0, j ≤ 2, k ≤ 4): ∫ :φ_y^{j+2}::φ_{y'}^k: ρ_A = −(j+1)(c − A⁻¹(y,y)) ∫ :φ_y^j::φ_{y'}^k: ρ_A + k A⁻¹(y,y') ∫ :φ_y^{j+1}::φ_{y'}^{k−1}: ρ_A.

Normalised G3 recursion for free Gaussian Wick moments (A ≻ 0, j ≤ 2, k ≤ 4), with δ_y = c − A⁻¹(y,y): E₀[:φ_y^{j+2}::φ_{y'}^k:] = −(j+1)δ_y E₀[:φ_y^j::φ_{y'}^k:] + k A⁻¹(y,y') E₀[:φ_y^{j+1}::φ_{y'}^{k−1}:].
Box, λ = 0, m₀ ≠ 0, c = freeVar, G = ε⁻² dirGreen: E₀[:φ_y²::φ_{y'}²:] = δ_yδ_{y'} + 2G(y,y')², δ_y = c − G(y,y).
Box, λ = 0, m₀ ≠ 0: E₀[:φ_y⁴::φ_{y'}⁴:] = 9δ_y²δ_{y'}² + 72G²δ_yδ_{y'} + 24G⁴, G = G(y,y'), δ_y = freeVar − G(y,y).
Row-sum bound (m₀ ≠ 0): Σ_y dirGreen x y ≤ 1/m₀² (maximum principle).
Diagonal heat bound keeping the mass: ε⁻² p_t(x,x) ≤ e^{−t m₀²} π/(4t) for t > 0.
Off-diagonal heat bound: |p_t(x,y)| ≤ (p_t(x,x) + p_t(y,y))/2 (any m₀, t).
Lᵖ bound for the box covariance (m₀ ≠ 0, natural p ≥ 2), uniformly in n, k, x: ε² Σ_y (ε⁻² dirGreen x y)^p ≤ (π/4)^{p−1}/2 · Γ(1/p)^p / m₀².
Lᵖ bound for the rough covariance C_r(T) = ∫_0^T heat kernel (any m₀, T ≥ 0, p ≥ 2), uniformly in n, k, x: ε² Σ_y |C_r(T)(x,y)|^p ≤ (π/4)^{p−1}/2 · p^p · T.
Spectral form of the rough covariance (T ≥ 0): C_r(T)(x,y) = ε⁻² Σ_K e_K(x)e_K(y)(1 − e^{−Tλ_K})/λ_K.
Schwarz with a free parameter: for ρ ≥ 0, with XYρ, X²ρ, Y²ρ integrable, ∫X²ρ ≤ a²Z, ∫Y²ρ ≤ b²Z (a ≥ 0, b > 0, Z ≥ 0) imply |∫XYρ| ≤ abZ.
Normalised Schwarz in the free measure (A ≻ 0, e, λ ≥ 0, X continuous of controlled growth): ⟨X²⟩₀ ≤ a², ⟨E²⟩₀ ≤ b², ⟨E⟩₀ ≥ z > 0 imply |⟨X⟩_λ| ≤ ab/z.
Jensen, tangent-line form: ⟨e^{−λV}⟩₀ ≥ e^{−λ⟨V⟩₀} for V = e Σ_z :φ_z⁴:_c (A ≻ 0, e ≥ 0, λ ≥ 0).

I2 correction bound, CONDITIONAL on the hypotheses NelsonRegionHyp, WickDefectHyp, WickL2Hyp (m₀ ≠ 0): ∃ K ≥ 0 with |12λε²Σ g C_B⟨:ψ²:⟩_λ| + |16λ²⟨F₁F_g⟩_λ| ≤ λΓK for 0 ≤ λ ≤ 1 and 0 ≤ g ≤ Γ on B = physBall x l.
Conditional on NelsonRegionHyp, WickDefectHyp, WickL2Hyp (m₀ ≠ 0, l ≥ 0): ∃ K ≥ 0, ∀ λ ∈ [0,1], SmallBoundarySum m₀ λ l (2/cosh(κl) + λK) and RegionSusceptibility m₀ λ l (1/m₀² + λK/m₀²).
Conditional on the three hypotheses (for all m₀ > 0, l ≥ 0): ∀ m₀ > 0, ∃ l ≥ 0, λ₀ > 0, A ≥ 0 such that for λ ∈ [0, λ₀): SmallBoundarySum m₀ λ l (3/4) ∧ RegionSusceptibility m₀ λ l A.
PhiFourTwoGapV3 CONDITIONAL on: NelsonRegionHyp, WickDefectHyp, WickL2Hyp (all m₀ > 0, l ≥ 0), non-Gaussianity of all limit points for small λ > 0, and SchwartzSeparable. Not unconditional.
Spectral form of the box action: dirAction(Aξ) = Σ_K ξ_K² for the mode map (Aξ)(x) = ε⁻¹ Σ_K λ_K^{−1/2} ξ_K e_K(x).
G1 (box): for every F and every m₀ (no hypotheses on F; Bochner integrals), (∫ F e^{−S/2})/(∫ e^{−S/2}) = ∫ F(Aξ) dγ^Λ(ξ), S = dirAction.
Measure form: the pushforward of the standard Gaussian γ^Λ under the mode map A equals the normalised measure (∫e^{−S/2})⁻¹ e^{−S/2} dφ.
G1 split (box): for measurable F and 0 ≤ α_K ≤ 1, the free Dirichlet expectation of F equals E[F(A(αξˢ) + A(βξʳ))], ξˢ, ξʳ independent standard Gaussian, β_K = √(1 − α_K²).
One-dimensional hypercontractive step: for 0 ≤ ρ ≤ 1 with (m+1)(2m+1)ρ² E_γ[P(1+ρ²P)^m] ≤ 1 (P = Σ_{k=1}^4 He_k²/k!), every b satisfies E_γ[(Σ_{k≤4} ρ^k b_k He_k)^{2m+2}] ≤ (Σ_k k! b_k²)^{m+1}.
Error-term bound for 0 ≤ ρ ≤ 1: (Σ_{k=1}^4 ρ^k b_k He_k(x))² ≤ ρ² (b₁² + 2b₂² + 6b₃² + 24b₄²) P(x).
Elementary inequality: (|u| + |e|)² ≤ (u² + s)(1 + r) when e² ≤ s r and s, r ≥ 0.
Admissibility: 52488 (m+1)⁶ ρ² ≤ 1 implies the hypothesis of oneDim_moment, (m+1)(2m+1)ρ² E_γ[P(1+ρ²P)^m] ≤ 1.
One-dimensional hypercontractive step with explicit ρ_m = 1/(230(m+1)³): E_γ[hpoly(ρ_m, b)^{2m+2}] ≤ (Σ_k k! b_k²)^{m+1}.
The same bound for every 0 ≤ ρ ≤ ρ_m.

Tensorised hypercontractive bound S(n), Bochner form: under the one-dimensional admissibility condition, E_{γⁿ}[F_{T_ρ c}^{2m+2}] ≤ (Σ_α α! c_α²)^{m+1} for all n and coefficient arrays c (per-variable degree ≤ 4).
L² identity: E_{γⁿ}[F_c²] = Σ_α α! c_α² for Hermite expansions F_c with per-variable degree ≤ 4.
Explicit hypercontractive bound, all n: E_{γⁿ}[F_{T_{ρ_m}c}^{2m+2}] ≤ (E_{γⁿ}[F_c²])^{m+1}, ρ_m = 1/(230(m+1)³).
Degree-d corollary: if c is supported on total degree |α| ≤ d then E[F_c^{2m+2}] ≤ (ρ_m^{−2d} E[F_c²])^{m+1}.
Ported from pphi2 (Apache-2.0): for an s-finite measure μ and measurable V, ∫⁻ exp(−V)² dμ ≤ μ(univ) + ∫⁻_{t>0} μ{V ≤ −t}·2e^{2t} dt.
Tail interface: if μ{V ≤ −t} ≤ ψ(t) for t > 0 then ∫⁻ exp(−V)² dμ ≤ μ(univ) + ∫⁻_{t>0} ψ(t)·2e^{2t} dt.

Abstract Nelson estimate: if μ = law of Φ_u under a probability P for every u ≥ 0, V∘Φ_u ≥ R_u − (a + bu²) pointwise and E[R_u^{2m+2}] ≤ (M(m+1)^p e^{−θu})^{m+1} for all m (b, M ≥ 0, θ > 0), then ∫⁻ e^{−2V} dμ ≤ an explicit N(a,b,M,θ,p).
Law of the split field: for T ≥ 0, φ_s + φ_r (independent smooth and rough parts) has the law A_*γ^Λ of the free Dirichlet field.
Markov at an even moment: if R − D ≤ W pointwise, D ≤ t/2, t ≥ 2 and ∫⁻ R^{2m+2} dP ≤ Y, then P{W ≤ −t} ≤ Y.
Wick binomial split of the box interaction V = ε² Σ :φ⁴:_{freeVar}: V(φs + φr) = V_s(φs) + R(φs, φr), Wick constants c₁(y) + c_r(y) = freeVar.
Smooth lower bound, pointwise: V_s(φ) ≥ −D(T) = −6 ε² Σ_y c₁(y)².
Reduction: nl_SmoothHyp ∧ nl_RoughL2Hyp ∧ nl_ChaosHyp (for m₀, k) ⇒ nl_NelsonBox m₀ k, i.e. ∃ N, ∀ n, ∀ λ ∈ [0,1], E⁰[exp(−2λ ε² Σ_y :φ_y⁴:)] ≤ N. Conditional on the three hypotheses.
Lattice sum of the boundary singularity: ε² Σ_y r(y)^{−1/2} ≤ 8 L^{3/2}, uniformly in n (L = boxL k).
The smooth-constant hypothesis nl_SmoothHyp m₀ k holds for every m₀ ≠ 0 and k.
Every real polynomial of total degree ≤ 4 in d variables equals a Hermite expansion F_c with c supported on |α| ≤ 4.
The chaos hypothesis nl_ChaosHyp m₀ k holds for every m₀ and k (the remainder R_T is a degree-≤ 4 polynomial in the 2|Λ| standard Gaussians).
For m₀ ≠ 0: nl_RoughL2Hyp m₀ k and nl_ChaosHyp m₀ k imply nl_NelsonBox m₀ k (smooth part discharged). Conditional on the rough L² hypothesis (discharged in PP2RoughL2).
For A positive definite and M = U diag(λ^{−1/2}): (Mξ)ᵀ A (Mξ) = Σ_K ξ_K².
G1 (generic, A ≻ 0): for every F (no hypotheses; Bochner integrals), (∫ F e^{−½φᵀAφ})/(∫ e^{−½φᵀAφ}) = ∫ F(Mξ) dγ^ι(ξ).
For A positive definite, A⁻¹ = U diag(λ⁻¹) Uᵀ (U the orthogonal eigenvector matrix of A).
Measure form (A ≻ 0): the pushforward of γ^ι under M equals the normalised measure (∫e^{−½φᵀAφ})⁻¹ e^{−½φᵀAφ} dφ.
Per-mode split: for 0 ≤ α_K ≤ 1, β_K = √(1 − α_K²), the map (ξˢ, ξʳ) ↦ αξˢ + βξʳ pushes γ^ι ⊗ γ^ι to γ^ι.
Generic split (A ≻ 0, measurable F, 0 ≤ α ≤ 1): the normalised Gaussian expectation of F equals E[F(M(αξˢ) + M(βξʳ))] under γ^ι ⊗ γ^ι.
Heat split (A ≻ 0, t ≥ 0, measurable F): the same with α_K = e^{−tλ_K/2}, β_K = √(1 − e^{−tλ_K}).
For A ≻ 0: ∫_0^∞ p_t(x,y) dt = A⁻¹(x,y).
Rough covariance (A ≻ 0, T ≥ 0): ∫_{(0,T]} p_t dt = U diag((1 − e^{−Tλ})/λ) Uᵀ.

Domain monotonicity of heat kernels for symmetric Z-matrices: if A is symmetric with A_ij ≤ 0 off the diagonal and A_B its restriction to B × B, then 0 ≤ p^{A_B}_t(x,y) ≤ p^A_t(x,y) for t ≥ 0, x, y ∈ B.
Region diagonal heat bound: ε⁻² p^B_t(x,x) ≤ e^{−tm₀²} π/(4t) for t > 0, uniformly in n, k, B, x.
Region rough Lᵖ bound (T ≥ 0, p ≥ 2): ε² Σ_{y∈B} |C^B_r(T)(x,y)|^p ≤ (π/4)^{p−1}/2 · p^p · T, uniformly in n, k, B, x.
Region Green Lᵖ bound (m₀ ≠ 0, p ≥ 2): ε² Σ_{y∈B} (ε⁻² regionGreen B x y)^p ≤ (π/4)^{p−1}/2 · Γ(1/p)^p/m₀².
G1 (region, m₀ ≠ 0): for every F, the normalised free region expectation with density qweight m₀ 0 (zeroExt B ψ) equals ∫ F(Mξ) dγ^B (Bochner integrals).
Generic split law (A ≻ 0, τ ≥ 0): φ_s + φ_r has the law M_*γ^ι.
Generic chaos bound: if F ∘ nr_e is a polynomial of total degree ≤ 4, then ∫⁻ F^{2m+2} ≤ (ρ_m^{−8} E[F²])^{m+1}.

Generic Nelson bound (A ≻ 0, w ≥ 0): if the smooth constant D(u) ≤ a + bu² and E[R_u²] ≤ K e^{−θu} (θ > 0, b ≥ 0) for all u ≥ 0, then for λ ∈ [0,1], ∫⁻ e^{−2λV} d(M_*γ^ι) ≤ 1 + nl_N(a, b, 230⁸ max(K,0), θ, 24).
The region chaos hypothesis nr_ChaosHyp m₀ l holds for every m₀ ≠ 0 and l.
Reduction (m₀ ≠ 0): nr_SmoothHyp m₀ l and nr_RoughL2Hyp m₀ l imply nl_NelsonRegion m₀ l. Conditional on those two hypotheses.
Variational bound for regions (m₀ ≠ 0): 2 w(a) − ⟨w, regionOp B w⟩ ≤ regionGreen B a a.
Region Wick defect (m₀ ≠ 0): if the odd sub-box of half-width M at x fits and lies in B, freeVar − ε⁻² regionGreen B x x ≤ (π/4)(1 + log⁺(1/(|m₀|ε(M+1)))).
Region smooth Wick constant (m₀ ≠ 0, 0 < T ≤ 1, fitting sub-box in B): 0 ≤ c₁(T)(y) ≤ (π/4)(1 + log⁺(1/(|m₀|ε(M+1)))) + (π/4)(log(1/T) + m₀⁻²).
Lattice volume of a ball (l ≥ 0): ε² |physBall x l| ≤ (2l+1)².
The region smooth-constant hypothesis nr_SmoothHyp m₀ l holds for m₀ ≠ 0, l ≥ 0 (6ε²Σ_{y∈B} c₁(T)(y)² ≤ a + b(log T)², uniformly in n, k, x).
For m₀ ≠ 0, l ≥ 0: the region rough L² hypothesis nr_RoughL2Hyp alone implies Nelson's bound nl_NelsonRegion m₀ l for the free region measures of B = physBall x l.
Markov on the (2m+2)-th moment: for c supported on |α| ≤ d and t > 0, γⁿ{|F_c| ≥ t} ≤ ((ρ_m^{−2d} Σ_α α!c_α²)/t²)^{m+1}.
Tail bound: for c supported on |α| ≤ d and s > 0, γⁿ{s‖F_c‖₂ < |F_c|} ≤ e · exp(−(s/(e·230^d))^{1/(3d)}).
A real polynomial in n variables of total degree ≤ d and degree ≤ 4 in each variable is F_c for some c supported on |α| ≤ d.
Reindexed tail bound: for P : MvPolynomial ι ℝ of total degree ≤ d, degree ≤ 4 per variable, under the standard Gaussian product on ι, P(|P(ξ)| > s‖P‖₂) ≤ e·exp(−(s/(e·230^d))^{1/(3d)}).
SchwartzSeparable holds: the Schwartz test-function space is separable for each finite seminorm schwartzSup a b (as defined in the posted V3 target).
Tail bound: ‖x‖^k ‖Dⁿh(x)‖ (1 + ‖x‖) ≤ 2^{a+1} ‖h‖_{a+1,b} for k ≤ a, n ≤ b.
For each a, b, R there is a countable D ⊆ TestFn whose image under Ψ_R is dense in the image of all test functions.
Bilinear expansion (A ≻ 0, j ≤ 4): ⟨(e Σ_z a_z :φ_z^j:_c)²⟩₀ = e² Σ_{z,z'} a_z a_{z'} E₀[:φ_z^j::φ_{z'}^j:].
Hypercontractive fourth moment (A ≻ 0, any c): F = e Σ_z a_z :φ_z³:_c has ⟨F⁴⟩₀ ≤ (ρ₁⁻⁶ ⟨F²⟩₀)².
Schur test: for H ≥ 0 symmetric with e Σ_{z'} H(z,z') ≤ S (e ≥ 0), e² Σ_{z,z'} u_z u_{z'} H(z,z') ≤ S · e Σ_z u_z².
Algebraic bound for the (3,3) Wick moment: e²ΣΣ a_z a_{z'}(9G δ_zδ_{z'} + 6G³) ≤ 9S·eΣ(a_zδ_z)² + 6K₃·eΣa_z², given G ≥ 0 symmetric, row sums ≤ S and cubic row sums ≤ K₃.
The hypothesis WickDefectHyp m₀ l of PP2M5Final holds for m₀ ≠ 0, l ≥ 0 (squared Wick defect ε²Σ_{z∈B}(freeVar − C_B(z,z))² bounded uniformly).
The hypothesis WickL2Hyp m₀ l (free L² Wick moments) holds for m₀ ≠ 0, l ≥ 0.
PhiFourTwoGapV3 CONDITIONAL on NelsonRegionHyp (all m₀ > 0, l ≥ 0) and non-Gaussianity of all limit points at small λ > 0; WickDefectHyp, WickL2Hyp and SchwartzSeparable are discharged.
Wick covariance of linear forms on ℝ^{Fin d} (degrees ≤ 4): E[:⟨u,x⟩^a:_{|u|²} :⟨v,x⟩^b:_{|v|²}] = δ_ab a! ⟨u,v⟩^a under the standard Gaussian.
The same for any finite index type ι: for ξ ~ γ^ι, Wick-ordered at the true variances, E[:X^a::Y^b:] = δ_ab a! ⟨u,v⟩^a (a, b ≤ 4).
Products of Wick powers of linear forms of γ^ι are integrable, for any Wick constants and degrees.
Mis-ordered Wick powers (j ≤ 3): if X = ⟨u,ξ⟩ has variance |u|² ≤ c, then E[(:X^j:_c)²] ≤ 15(1 + c)³.
Rough Wick covariance (T ≥ 0, a, b ≤ 4): E[:φ_r(y)^a:_{c_r(y)} :φ_r(y')^b:_{c_r(y')}] = δ_ab a! C_r(T)(y,y')^a.
Exact second moment of the Nelson remainder (T ≥ 0): E[R_T²] = ε⁴ Σ_{y,y'} Σ_{j<4} C(4,j)² E[S_j(y)S_j(y')] (4−j)! C_r(y,y')^{4−j}.
Mis-ordered smooth covariances (m₀ ≠ 0, T ≥ 0, j ≤ 3): |E[S_j(y)S_j(y')]| ≤ (M(y) + M(y'))/2.
